title: Italy Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees & Process | SK Immigration
description: Italy study visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, common mistakes and FAQ. Honest guidance by SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are the main requirements for a Italy study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Typically admission/offer documents, proof of funds, passport, academic records, and any language or medical checks Italy requires. Exact lists change — SK Immigration builds a country checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How long does a Italy student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 3–6 months depending on Universitaly / pre-enrolment and appointment slots Peak intakes and incomplete files take longer.

faqs.question: What are typical fees for Italy study visa Pakistan applicants?
faqs.answer: Embassy/VFS fees + living proof; SK packages from PKR 50,000. Official fees are paid to universities/missions; our service fee covers preparation only.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide every application. We prepare honest, complete files and explain risks clearly.

faqs.question: Can SK Immigration help with attestation for Italy?
faqs.answer: Yes — we sequence Apostille/MOFA/embassy steps when your destination requires legalized Pakistani documents.

faqs.question: Is IELTS always required?
faqs.answer: Not always. Some programs accept MOI letters, university tests or other evidence. We map realistic language pathways case by case.

Requirements

  • Admission / pre-enrolment via the Italian university process
  • Proof of sufficient funds and accommodation plan
  • Valid passport, photos, visa application
  • Academic documents with required legalization/translation
  • Health insurance for Schengen study stay

Deeper country guide

Read our educational guide: Italy student visa guide. Also explore the Answers Hub for IELTS, funds and attestation questions.

Italy study pathway from Pakistan — Universitaly first

Italy is not a “print offer and run to VFS” destination. Many non-EU degree applicants need the correct pre-enrolment / Universitaly (or university-portal) steps before a national study visa file is credible. SK Immigration sequences admission paperwork, attestation and appointment timing; the Italian mission decides.

Who Italy suits

  • Students targeting public or private Italian universities with a clear programme match
  • Applicants ready to follow portal steps and document legalization carefully
  • Profiles that can show tuition + living funds without relying on illegal work stories

Process map (high level — verify current portals)

  1. Programme shortlist and academic fit check
  2. University application / admission evidence
  3. Pre-enrolment or portal steps required for your nationality and intake
  4. Funds, insurance, housing evidence as listed by the mission
  5. Visa appointment / biometrics — complete file first

Language & IELTS

Italian-taught programmes usually need Italian language evidence; English-taught programmes may ask IELTS/TOEFL or university English proof. Do not assume MOI is enough unless the university states it in writing.

Pakistan-specific pitfalls

  • Skipping Universitaly / pre-enrolment when your case type requires it
  • Unattested or inconsistently named academics
  • Funds that cover only tuition screenshots, not living
  • Booking VFS before portal status is clear
